newsitem.title: USA: Cincinnati Bell names James Orr COO.
newsitem.headline: Cincinnati Bell names James Orr COO.

text.p: Cincinnati Bell Inc said on Tuesday James Orr had been elected chief operating officer and a director.

The company said in a statement Orr, 50, had been executive vice president of Cincinnati Bell, and president and chief executive of its information management subsidiary, Cincinnati Bell Information Systems (CBIS).
He succeeds Cincinnati Bell president and chief executive John LaMacchia as chief operating officer. LaMacchia retains the posts of president and chief executive.
Robert Marino, 49, succeeds Orr as president and chief executive of CBIS. Marino joined CBIS in October 1995.
"Given our aggressive growth plans, it's time to break apart the COO and CEO roles to provide our excellent management team with the support they need to execute their strategies," LaMacchia said
